sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B official model card
sources.evidence: Exact post-trained checkpoint; the Language Model section gives nominal 35B total/3B activated. Documents text, image and video examples, native 262,144-token context, thinking and tool use.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration; 40 language layers mixing linear and full attention; 256 routed experts with eight selected, a shared expert, vision encoder and one MTP layer; max_position_embeddings=262144.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release news (Qwen3.6 repository redirects here)
sources.evidence: News explicitly dates Qwen3.6-35B-A3B availability on Hugging Face and ModelScope to 2026-04-16. Repository identifies the Qwen team with Alibaba Group and covers the Qwen3.6 series.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B license
sources.evidence: Exact repository contains the Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: Official checkpoint metadata and Safetensors count
sources.evidence: Public, ungated repository. Safetensors metadata counts 35,951,822,704 BF16 parameters. Repository creation is 2026-04-15, which alone does not establish public availability that day.

sources.title: Official checkpoint index and referenced shard headers
sources.evidence: Direct HTTP retrieval succeeded after the web reader failed. Independently summed tensor-shape products from all 26 referenced shard headers: 1,045 BF16 tensors, 35,951,822,704 parameters. Decoder including embeddings/output head: 34,660,610,688; vision: 446,571,248; MTP: 844,640,768. Names exactly match the index and payload bytes match total_size=71,903,645,408.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: Agentic Coding Power, Now Open to All
sources.evidence: Article published April 17, 2026 describes this open-weight MoE and thinking/non-thinking modes. This publication date is later than the official repository release notice.

sources.title: Official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B chat template
sources.evidence: Handles text, image and video content, assistant text, thinking controls, tool declarations, function calls and tool responses; no audio-content path.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B checkpoint history
sources.evidence: History labels its April 15 commit Initial public release. This is an earlier artifact timestamp than the April 16 public availability notice; historical repository visibility cannot be recovered from the commit date.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B release blog
sources.evidence: Linked by the official model card and release news, but the web reader returned no article text. No claims rely on its unread content.

name.note: Existing display name corresponds to the official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B identifier.

developer.note: Official Qwen team repository identifies Alibaba Group; Alibaba Cloud publishes the model announcement.

family.note: Exact checkpoint belongs to the Qwen3.6 series within Qwen.

release_date.note: Use the explicit official weight-availability notice. April 17 is the Alibaba Cloud article date. An April 15 checkpoint commit is titled Initial public release, but commit/repository creation time does not establish when weights became publicly accessible; retain this artifact-versus-announcement discrepancy.

open_weights.note: Official public repository exposes the complete downloadable checkpoint.

license.note: Exact model repository license is Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Complete stored checkpoint count in decimal billions, independently computed from every tensor shape and corroborated by Hub metadata. Includes vision and auxiliary MTP. The advertised 35B is the rounded language-model count, not the complete checkpoint.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal activated language-model parameters in billions; not an independently measured full multimodal/MTP active count. Scope is proposed as language_decoder.

architecture.note: Sparse MoE language decoder uses Gated DeltaNet and gated full attention, with eight routed experts plus one shared expert per layer; checkpoint also has vision and MTP components.

context_window.note: Native configured context is 262,144 tokens; the model card separately documents extension to 1,010,000.

modalities.note: Exact template and examples support these inputs and text generation. Video processing uses visual frames; audio is not a documented modality.

reasoning.note: Thinking is supported with a non-thinking option; template exposes enable_thinking and preserve_thinking.

tool_call.note: Exact template supports functions and tool responses, and model-card serving instructions enable the tool-call parser.

description.value: Open-weight multimodal Qwen MoE supporting text, image and video input, text output, reasoning and tool calling.
description.note: Replace the unsupported audio claim with the verified input/output modalities and capabilities; no benchmark-superiority claim is retained.

patch.description: Open-weight multimodal Qwen MoE supporting text, image and video input, text output, reasoning and tool calling.
patch.notes: Full checkpoint: 35.951822704B stored parameters including the vision encoder and auxiliary MTP. The model card reports nominal 35B total and 3B activated for the language model; 3B is not a full multimodal/MTP active count. Official weight availability is dated April 16, 2026; the Alibaba Cloud article is April 17. The checkpoint has an April 15 commit labelled Initial public release, which does not independently establish its historical visibility.

summary: Correct release date from April 17 article publication to the explicit April 16 official availability notice, with an April 15 artifact-timestamp caveat. Add Apache-2.0, replace nominal 35B total with the verified complete 35.951822704B checkpoint count, and retain nominal 3B active with decoder scope. Remove unsupported audio from the description. MoE architecture, native context, text/image/video input, text output, reasoning and tool calling are confirmed for this exact checkpoint.
